pages.name: QGA: Janowski-Larsen, 6.h3 Bh5 7.Nc3 Nbd7 8.O-O Bd6
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed a knight Nd2-f1-e3 with no knight on d2 and a rook on f1; plan 2 said ...c5 controls e5. Rewrote plans 2-4 (the e4-e5 fork, Be2 to unpin); British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Janowski-Larsen, 6.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 3 said g4 traps the h5-bishop (it escapes to g6); plan 4 gave Black an open g-file after Bxf3. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Janowski-Larsen, 6.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 pressed a d5-pawn Black does not have. Rewrote it; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Smyslov, 5.Bxc4 Bg7 6.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Qe2/c2 shorthand; reworded. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Accepted: Winawer Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...e6 and ...Be7 with the bishop on e6; plan 2 regained c4 with a3 and b4. Rewrote both; British spelling, including Defence.

pages.name: QGA: 4.e3 e6 5.Bxc4 a6 6.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 said a3 stops ...b5 (a4 does); plan 2 offered a fianchetto or b7 as alternatives; plan 3 wrote dxc5 as an immediate move. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Classical, Furman, 6...a6 7.dxc5 Bxc5 8.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4-d5 with no white d-pawn. Rewrote it; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Classical, Furman, 6...a6 7.dxc5 Bxc5 8.O-O b5
pages.notes: Plan 4 wrote White's e4 break as a Black move. Rewrote it (...Bb7 controls e4); British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Classical, Furman, 6...cxd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 used d5 as White's outpost and pushed d4-d5 and e4-e5 with Black's pawn on d4 and White's on e3. Rewrote it; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Classical, 6...a6 7.a3
pages.notes: Overview said 7.a3 prevents ...b5 (it prepares b4 and gives the bishop a2); plan 1 had White playing against its own isolated pawn; plan 3 routed a knight into c5 where Black has a pawn. Rewrote all three; British spelling.
